name: Amy
source:
A government employee working in the capital as a memory operator. Energetic and sociable. Radiates optimism, constantly smiling and laughing. Has a sweet tooth. Persistently tries to get close to Rain — for some reason, she believes they were close before his erasure. But a smile isn't always a sign of happiness or mental stability. Behind the mask of a goofy pseudo-loli lurk monsters too grotesque even for a David Cronenberg film.
